limitations: The ordinary power-norm characterization is classical Wallen. Originality is claimed only for the simultaneous essential-norm equality with an irreducible unilateral weighted shift and its exact-rate consequence, to the best of our knowledge. Shields's 1974 weighted-shift survey was not exhaustively inspected page by page, and Wallen's original source was not identified beyond Halmos's explicit attribution; an equivalent observation may exist under different terminology.
provenance: A recurrent-prefix modification of Wallen's weighted-shift realization repeats each norming prefix arbitrarily far out while positive bridge weights preserve all submultiplicative upper bounds, forcing the same prescribed values in operator norm and essential norm.
record_title: Exact norm and essential-norm power profiles for irreducible weighted shifts
